# Task: fix review finding F1 on YOUR PR #6981 (delegate --force-new live-task guard)

You are grok, addressing the cross-family review verdict (FAIL, one blocking finding) posted on
your PR #6981 (fix(delegate): fail closed on task-id reuse, archive on --force-new). One
bounded change; do not start other work.

## Finding F1 (from the review comment on the PR — read it in full first)
The `--force-new` branch in `cmd_dispatch` has no alive-PID check: for an existing record with
`status in {running, spawning}` and a LIVE pid, `--force-new` archives the live worker's state
file and spawns a duplicate worker under the same task-id — the duplicate-worker race the old
guard refused with NO escape (#5643 CF F001). `build_dispatch_fix_command` passes `--force-new`
unconditionally, so the wrapper path hits this automatically.

## Steps
1. Work in your existing dispatch worktree for this branch
   (`.worktrees/dispatch/grok/infra-6980-taskid-guard`, branch `grok/infra-6980-taskid-guard`).
2. Inside the `force_new` branch of the #6980 guard in `scripts/delegate.py`: when
   `existing.get("status") in ("running", "spawning")` AND `_pid_alive(int(pid))`, REFUSE
   (rc 2) with a message stating force-new has no escape for live tasks — before any
   archiving.
3. Test (mutation-proof, matching the existing style): live-pid running record +
   `force_new=True` → rc 2, state file unchanged, NO archive files created, `subprocess.Popen`
   not called (monkeypatch it to raise). Parametrize running + spawning.
4. Run: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_delegate.py tests/test_ab_dispatch_wrappers.py`
   and `.venv/bin/ruff check scripts/delegate.py tests/test_delegate.py`. Quote output.
5. Commit (conventional, references #6980 + the F1 comment). You cannot push — leave the
   worktree committed and clean; report the new head SHA. The driver pushes and re-requests
   the delta review.
6. NO auto-merge, NO merge.
